2: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of the Lord forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
3: I indeed declare, "Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them."
4: "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
5: 'I will establish your seed forever, and build up your throne to all generations.'" Selah.
6: The heavens will praise your wonders, Lord; your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
7: For who in the skies can be compared to the Lord? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the Lord,
8: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
9: Lord, God of Hosts, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
10: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
11: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
12: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours; the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
13: The north and the south, you have created them. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
14: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
15: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
16: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Lord.
17: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
18: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
19: For our shield belongs to the Lord; our king to the Holy One of Israel.
20: Then you spoke in vision to your holy ones, and said, "I have bestowed strength on the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
21: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
22: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
23: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
24: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
25: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
26: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
27: He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!'
28: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
29: I will keep my loving kindness for him forevermore. My covenant will stand firm with him.
30: I will also make his seed endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
31: If his children forsake my Law, and do not walk in my ordinances;
32: if they break my statutes, and do not keep my commandments;
33: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
34: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
35: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
36: Once have I sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
37: His seed will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
38: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah.
39: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
40: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
41: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
42: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
43: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
44: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven't supported him in battle.
45: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
46: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
47: How long, Lord? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
48: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men!
49: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
50: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
51: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
52: With which your enemies have mocked, Lord, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
53: Blessed be the Lord forevermore. Amen, and Amen.
